text:
eli: quick heads-up — the base-image harden rollout hit a signing failure during canary. cosign returned AccessDenied for kms:Sign from two builder pools. planning a short window to patch RBAC or use an ephemeral signing key. who can own?
sana: I'll take RBAC triage. what exact error shows in the logs?
mikael: logs: `Error: AccessDenied; CallerNotAuthorized: kms:Sign denied for principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ci-builder-ephemeral`. Trust policy for the build-runner role only lists builders-prod. ephemeral pools were missed during the role migration.
eli: thanks. two options on the table: 1) quickly edit assume-role trust to add the ephemeral principal with tight conditions (sourceVpc, tag=ephemeral:true) and revert later, or 2) create an ephemeral asymmetric KMS key for the window and grant that key only to ephemeral builders. preferences?
sana: prefer ephemeral key to avoid touching production key policy in-flight. less blast radius. but we must ensure provenance — upload the public key and record attestations.
sec-bot: Reminder: any RBAC or key changes must be logged in SEC-XXXX and include justification. Ephemeral key TTL <= 24h and must be tagged `ephemeral:true`. CloudTrail will capture Sign events; ensure trail sends to s3://redwood-audit/images/signs/ and SIEM.
mikael: if we use ephemeral key, cosign will output signatures referencing the key id. we need to annotate image manifests with `signing.key.id` and push the public key to provenance path `s3://redwood-provenance/keys/<key-id>.pem` so verification later is auditable.
eli: ops checklist for 20:00 PT window: 1) open SEC ticket with justification and TTL, 2) create ephemeral asymmetric key (ECDSA_P256) with tag ephemeral:true, 3) grant kms:Sign+kms:GetPublicKey to role/ci-builder-ephemeral only, 4) set CI COSIGN_KEY_URI -> ksm://.../key-ephemeral-1728456789, 5) run a single smoke build+sign, 6) cosign verify and push attestation to attestation store, 7) upload pubkey to provenance bucket, 8) disable key and revert if everything is green.
sana: I'll open SEC-8799 and add the justification text. tagging: `hotpatch:sign-fix`. Also note: update IAM docs with a decision whether ephemeral pools are allowed persistent access.
mikael: small scan note while we have the window: vulnerability scanner flagged `CVE-2026-2199 libssl` on an auxiliary runtime image. It's medium and used only in sidecar. plan: pin to patched distro package and re-run image-scan as part of this window.
eli: block cutover until scan is green. sanamikael: coordinate Dockerfile pin PR and mark `security/owner` ready.
sana: PR opened: `security/fix-libssl-pin-172845` — setting base image pin and adding `apt-get upgrade libssl1.1=1.1.1x` step. CI will re-run tests.
sec-bot: Add audit requirement: for sign events include `requestParameters.keyId`, `userIdentity.principalId`, and `additionalEventData.NS` fields in the audit bundle. Retain audit bundle for 390 days.
mikael: added short snippet to the runbook for verification: ```bash
# verify all images in env
for IMG in "${IMAGES[@]}"; do
  cosign verify --key "ksm://projects/PROJ/locations/global/keyRings/r/cryptoKeys/key-ephemeral-1728456789" "$IMG" || { echo "VERIFY FAIL: $IMG"; exit 1; }
done
```
eli: oncall: can you standby to open #release-war-room if verify fails?
oncall: oncall here — will watch and open war-room on failure. link runbook: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ops/pages/IMG-HARDEN-RUNBOOK.
sana: small RBAC nuance: if we edit assume-role trust instead of ephemeral key, require condition `StringEquals: { "aws:RequestTag/ephemeral": "true" }` and `IpAddress` restriction to build subnet. That allows automatic revocation when tag is removed. but it still touches production role.
eli: agree ephemeral key is safer for now. make sure to export the pubkey and add manifest fields: `provenance.signatures[0].keyId` and `provenance.signatures[0].keyUri`.
mikael: I'll push that metadata as part of the signing step. also ensure rekor (or our attestation store) is used and the UUID is stored in the manifest under `provenance.attestations`.
sec-bot: If ephemeral key used, postmortem required only if escape hatch used for >1 hour or if any unexplained sign events appear. Otherwise a short note in SEC ticket suffices.
sana: creating ephemeral key now and will set tags ttl=12h. updating CI env. ping here when updated.
eli: thanks. keep replies concise during window. after successful verify we'll run an audit query: list CloudTrail Sign events where keyId contains key-ephemeral-1728456789 and principalArn starts with arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ci-builder-ephemeral. attach screenshots to SEC-8799.
mikael: ephemeral sign successful for canary images. cosign verify passed. pushing Dockerfile pin PR and re-running scans.
sec-bot: Vulnerability scan queued for `base-minimal:172845-hotfix`. status: queued.
sana: good work. I'll mark SEC-8799 with `status: monitoring` and schedule revert check at +12h. thanks everyone.
